Maximum painted points on an N x N square grid with no axis-parallel square (tilted squares remain legal)
solutions/sq-axis_n11_m73.model.xz | A227133(11) = 73 | 0 axis squares (100 legal tilted)
OEIS A227133 / A152125 Ladder & Open Frontier (8 CNFs)
Known optimal through N = 13; N = 14 lower bound 112 (Karpov 2016)
- Complementary A152125(N) = N^2 - A227133(N) (min hitting set).
